reviews.title: Good performance, but pricey for what it is
reviews.comment:
I got this to boost my laptop without having to keep a full desktop tower around, and it does a genuinely good job of that. The performance jump is easy to feel — games and heavier graphics tasks run smoother, and it makes the laptop feel like a much more capable machine when connected.
The build quality is solid and it looks nice on the desk. It’s a bit on the heavy side, but that’s also what makes it feel sturdy instead of flimsy. It stays quiet while running and doesn’t throw heat into the room, which is great during long sessions.
The one reason I wouldn’t give it a full five stars is the price. It performs well and does what it’s supposed to do, but it’s still an expensive piece of hardware. For what it costs, I’d expect just a little more flexibility or future-proofing, especially since you can’t upgrade the GPU inside later.
That said, if you want desktop-level graphics power in a cleaner, smaller setup, it delivers. I’m happy with it overall — it just falls short of “perfect” at this price point.
